references.text: Describes how birds find shelter in trees, similar to the image of birds finding refuge in the mustard plant.
Uses a tree as a symbol of a kingdom that grows large and provides shelter for birds, paralleling the growth of the mustard seed and its refuge for birds.
Describes a great tree that gives shelter to birds, similar to the image Jesus uses about the mustard seed.
Matthew's version of the parable of the mustard seed, which offers a parallel account.
Luke's version of the parable of the mustard seed, which offers a parallel account.
